title: Vivli Platform Outcomes and Impact: Analysis Code and Data
description: Analysis code and underlying data used to produce the metrics and figures reported in the Vivli platform paper (Patterns, Cell Press, 2026), covering approved data access requests and resulting public disclosures from December 2018 through December 2025. The manuscript figure is fully reproducible from the included derived datasets. NOTE: this is the analysis and metrics code, not the Vivli platform production source code.
